name: unbiased-headlines
description: Search non-partisan, multi-source news briefings from Unbiased Headlines, with an open −1..+1 bias score and source breakdown for every story.

interface.longDescription: Unbiased Headlines writes concise, neutral news briefings by cross-referencing outlets across the political spectrum — left, center and right. Search the latest stories by topic or category, read a briefing, and see exactly how balanced it is: every story carries an openly published political bias score from −1 (left) to +1 (right), the number of sources it was built from, and the left/center/right breakdown of those sources. Every result links back to the full article on unbiasedheadlines.com. Read-only; no account required.
defaultPrompt: Use Unbiased Headlines to give me today's top stories.
Search Unbiased Headlines for the latest on energy policy.
How balanced is the coverage of this Unbiased Headlines story?
